correctness.rationale: PASS. For each of 72 representative cases (six forbidden-four patterns, n=4,...,15), independently parsed the actual 1,146,591-byte certificates.json blob and generated every mandatory n-bit word by ordinary nonwrapping forbidden-factor testing. Independently reconstructed required de Bruijn arc imbalances, all supplementary integer flow changes and cost, verified every vertex balance is zero, every directed arc satisfies potential(head)-potential(tail)<=1, exact primal-dual objective equality, strong connectivity of active directed graph in both orientations, and every printed table value. The 72 distinct certificates had 193,330 required arcs, 89,657 supplementary multiplicities and maximum 16,384 vertices; zero validation errors. Euler existence and one-circle coverage follow from balanced strongly connected directed multigraph containing each required arc. Reversal/complementation gives all 16 forbidden patterns. This proves only orders n<=15.
